liturgicalDay.feastOrSaint: Wednesday of the twentieth week of Ordinary Time

verseOfDay.text: The kingdom of heaven is like to an householder, who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

prayer.title: The Hail Mary
prayer.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace,
the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou amongst women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
prayer.note: Scripture and the Church, in four lines. Good for a truck cab or a stairwell.

consider.question: Why do Catholics have to go to Mass on Sunday?
consider.answer: Sunday is the day of the Resurrection, and the Church asks Catholics to keep it by taking part in Mass on Sunday or Saturday evening, together with the holy days of obligation. It is a real obligation, binding those who can meet it. Deliberately skipping Mass without a serious reason is grave matter.
